meta.title: Flower garden
meta.description: A living garden with four grounds and 45 distinct flowers. Keep resident plants, preserve their individual appearance, observe them and grow repeat blooms. Every species has an ecological role, theme season, visitor preference and research notebook. Field studies renew every six hours, consuming coins and ribbons for permanent research seals without consuming flowers. Includes hybrids, twelve curiosities, markets and themed shows. Click any of thirteen visitors for a portrait, scientific name, real ecology and sources. Saved locally; no background network requests. Source links open only on click. Special letters offer bespoke bouquets, living exhibits, breeding exchanges and visitor sightings with varied rewards and permanent reputation.
